## Jit issue management

The sole prerequisite is done, and repository validation passed.

1. **High — invalid strictness values are accepted by configuration parsing and `jit config set`, contradicting the documented rejection behavior.** [`ValidationConfig.strictness`](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/config.rs:299) is `Option<String>`, so TOML deserialization accepts arbitrary values; the config loader does not resolve it, and [`set_config`](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/commands/config.rs:253) writes arbitrary strings. Thus `strictness = "banana"` persists successfully and only fails later on selected write/transition paths, violating REQ-02’s parsing agreement and the reference claim that unrecognized values are rejected.

2. **Medium — new public API documentation lacks an example.** [`ValidationConfig::strictness`](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/config.rs:329) is public and documented, but has no `# Examples` section, violating the required public-API documentation standard.
